_method: docs/i18n/sum/SUM_METHOD.md — SCHOLARLY DRAFT, part 1 (k17–k29). Transliteration is the Sumerian master; cuneiform derives from docs/i18n/sum/signmap.json. Tokens in ⟦…⟧ pass through in Latin. Each record: e = English master sentence (verbatim), t = draft transliteration (ePSD2 ASCII), g = literal back-gloss of what the Sumerian actually says.

k17.g: every land comes forth from thought

k17.e: Before a law is written, a bridge is built, a machine is made, or a future is changed, someone imagines what does not yet exist.
k17.t: di nu-sar • e2 nu-du3 • gesz dim2-ma nu-dim2 • u4 egir-ra nu-bal • lu2-e nig2 nu-gal2-la igi-bar mu-un-gar
k17.g: the judgment not yet written, the house not yet built, the implement not yet fashioned, the after-days not yet turned — a person sets a vision upon what does not exist
thought turns into the thing of the heart (intent)

k17.e: Action enters time, the one resource no person can recover.
k17.t: kin u4-sze3 mu-un-du • u4 zal-la lu2 nu-mu-un-gi4
k17.g: the work goes into time — time passed, no person brings back
Vision • 2525 stands up from that place

k17.e: Not with technology, money, government, or Artificial Intelligence, but with Humanity and the time through which every Human life is lived.
k17.t: gesz dim2-ma-ta nu • ku3-ta nu • nam-lugal-ta nu • gesztu2 dim2-ma-ta nu • nam-lu2-ulu3-ta u3 u4 zi lu2-ka til3-la-ta-am3
k17.g: not from the fashioned implement, not from silver, not from kingship, not from fashioned understanding — it is from humankind and from the time in which a person's life is lived

k17.e: We call the discipline connecting awareness, intention, time, action, consequence, and learning Thought Mastery.
k17.t: zu-a • sza3 • u4 • kin • egir-bi • zu-zu • kaskal-bi disz-am3 • mu-bi nam-gesztu2-am3
k17.g: the known, the heart, time, work, its aftermath, learning — their road is one; its name is Thought Mastery

k17.e: A person who accepts the continuing responsibility to practice that discipline becomes a Thought Master.
k17.t: lu2 nam-kin kaskal-bi-ka szu ti-a lu2 gesztu2-ga-am3
k17.g: the person who receives in hand the charge of that road is a Thought Master

k17.e: Master of Thought names the responsibility behind the practice.
k17.g: EN SAG.KI — it is the name of the charge

k17.e: It is not a throne above Humanity, nor a claim of intellectual superiority.
k17.t: dur2 nam-lu2-ulu3-ka an-ta in-nu • inim mah gesztu2-ka in-nu
k17.g: it is not a seat above humankind; it is not a proud word of understanding

k17.e: It is an invitation within Humanity: become aware of what you think, understand what you build, remain accountable for what follows, recognize when evidence changes what you know, and leave enough truth for another person to learn from what you experienced.
k17.t: inim sza3 nam-lu2-ulu3-ka-am3 • gesztu2-zu he2-zu • nig2 du3-a-zu he2-zu • egir-bi-ra en he2-me • nig2-gi-na-e zu-a bal-a he2-zu • nig2-gi-na lu2 egir-ra-ra he2-gal2
k17.g: it is a word inside humankind: may you know your thought; may you know what you build; may you be lord to its aftermath; may you know when proof turns the known; may firm truth remain for the person after

k18.e: That is why Measurement of Time matters.
k18.g: therefore the reckoning of time is great

k18.e: The clock records what actually passed.
k18.t: gesz u4 szid-da-ke4 u4 zal-la gi-na mu-un-sar
k18.g: the day-counting implement writes the time that truly passed

k18.e: Human Intelligence records what qualified contribution emerged through that time.
k18.t: gesztu2 nam-lu2-ulu3-ka-ke4 nig2 sum-ma gi-na u4-bi-ta e3-a mu-un-sar
k18.g: the understanding of humankind writes the proven given-thing that came forth in that time

k18.e: The two must never be confused.
k18.g: the one and the other — may they not be turned into one

k18.e: A base HI unit can be anchored to one Human hour while qualified contribution recognizes greater value through an explicit multiple.
k18.t: ⟦HI⟧ asz danna-bar disz lu2-ka-ta mu-un-gub • nig2 sum-ma gi-na szid mah igi-a gal2-la-ta mi2 du11-ga-am3
k18.g: one HI stands from one human half-danna; the proven given-thing is honored through a great count standing in view

k18.e: The framework separates them so none can quietly impersonate another.
k18.t: gesz-hur-e bar-sze3 mu-un-gar • disz disz-gin7 lul-la nu-mu-un-du
k18.g: the design sets them apart — one does not go falsely as another
the people's word is not the firm truth of the craft
the looking-upon is not the firm ground

k18.e: Artificial Intelligence is not Human Authority.
k18.g: the fashioned understanding is not the lordship of humankind
what the eye has known is not the firm count
the firm heart is not the seal of proof

k18.e: Thought Mastery begins by seeing distinctions clearly enough that power cannot hide inside confusion.
k18.t: nam-gesztu2-e bar-bar igi-ta mu-un-pad3 • a2 mah sza3 lul-la-ka nu-mu-un-ku
k18.g: thought-mastery finds the separations with the eye — great strength cannot sit inside the heart of falsehood

k19.e: Vision • 2525 carries this discipline toward 2525, not because anyone today can predict five centuries, but because responsibility can reach farther than certainty.
k19.t: ⟦Vision • 2525⟧-e kaskal-bi ⟦2525⟧-sze3 mu-un-tum2 • lu2 u4-ne-ka egir nu-mu-un-zu • nam-kin zu-a-ta gid2-da-am3
k19.g: Vision • 2525 carries this road toward 2525; the person of today does not know the after; the charge is longer than the known

k19.e: What Humanity builds should preserve what happened, what changed, why it changed, what evidence existed, and what was learned.
k19.t: nig2 nam-lu2-ulu3-e du3-a-e • nig2 gal2-la • nig2 bal-a • inim sag bal-a-ka • nig2-gi-na gal2-la • u3 nig2 zu-a szu he2-tuku
k19.g: what humankind builds — may it hold in hand what was, what turned, the head-word of the turning, the proof that existed, and what was learned

k19.e: Future generations should inherit more than conclusions.
k19.t: dumu egir-ra-e-ne inim egir-ra-ta mah szu he2-ti
k19.g: may the children of after receive in hand more than the final word

k19.e: They should inherit the ability to question them.
k19.g: may they receive in hand the arm of cutting questions at them

k19.e: That is Thought Mastery at civilization scale: awareness before action, evidence before confidence, Humanity before technology, and learning carried through time.
k19.t: nam-gesztu2 kalam-ma-am3 • zu-a igi kin-ka • nig2-gi-na igi sza3 gi-na-ka • nam-lu2-ulu3 igi gesz dim2-ma-ka • zu-zu u4-ta tum2-ma
k19.g: it is thought-mastery of the land: the known before the work, proof before the firm heart, humankind before the fashioned implement, learning carried through time

k19.e: We cannot master what we are not aware of.
k19.g: over the unknown thing, no lordship exists

k19.e: We cannot improve what we refuse to measure.
k19.g: the uncounted thing is not turned toward the better

k19.e: We cannot build a trustworthy future if every generation must begin again.
k19.t: dumu-e sag-ta mu-un-gi4-gi4-a • u4 egir-ra gi-na nu-mu-un-du3
k19.g: if the children return ever to the start, a firm future is not built

k20.t: lu2 du3-a-bi kaskal bar-ra-ta zi-sze3 mu-un-du
k20.g: every person goes into life by a separate road

k20.e: Geography, language, family, wealth, opportunity, health, education, and circumstance are unequal from the beginning.
k20.t: ki • eme • e2 • ku3 • kaskal gal2-la • nam-til3 • e2-dub-ba-a • ki gub-ba • sag-ta sa2 nu-gal2
k20.g: place, tongue, house, silver, the open road, life, the tablet-house, the standing-place — from the start no equality exists
Vision • 2525 speaks no false word about it

k20.e: It begins with something simpler: every Human life unfolds through time.
k20.t: nig2 tur-ta mu-un-gub • zi lu2 du3-a-bi u4-ta mu-un-du
k20.g: it stands from a small thing: every person's life goes through time

k20.e: A minute lived in Austin and a minute lived in Phnom Penh contain the same duration, even when economies value labor differently.
k20.t: u4 tur ⟦Austin⟧-a til3-la u3 u4 tur ⟦Phnom Penh⟧-a til3-la • nig2-szid-bi disz-am3 • ku3 kin-ka bar-bar-am3
k20.g: a small time lived in Austin and a small time lived in Phnom Penh — their measure is one, though the silver of work is various

k20.e: Measurement of Time records that duration honestly.
k20.g: the reckoning of time writes that time toward the truth

k20.e: It does not claim every hour produces identical work, creates identical contribution, or buys identical goods.
k20.t: danna-bar du3-a-bi kin disz-am3 nu-mu-un-du11 • nig2 sum-ma disz-am3 nu-mu-un-du11 • ku3 disz-am3 nu-mu-un-du11
k20.g: it does not say every half-danna is one same work, one same given-thing, one same silver

k20.e: It establishes a common reference from which contribution can be understood without allowing geography alone to determine whether a Human life or Human effort becomes visible.
k20.t: nig2-szid disz kalam-sze3 mu-un-gar • ki asz-e zi lu2-ka igi-sze3 gal2-la ka-asz nu-mu-un-bar
k20.g: it sets one measure for the land — place alone does not cut the decision whether a person's life stands in view

k20.e: Time provides a shared measure without pretending circumstances are shared.
k20.t: u4-e nig2-szid disz mu-un-sum • ki gub-ba disz-am3 nu-mu-un-du11
k20.g: time gives one measure; it does not say the standing-places are one

k20.e: That distinction matters because equality of duration does not mean equality of opportunity, contribution, need, difficulty, or consequence.
k20.t: bar-bi mah-am3 • u4 sa2-am3 • kaskal gal2-la • nig2 sum-ma • nig2 al du11-ga • kin husz • u3 egir-bi sa2 nu-me-a
k20.g: that separation is great: time is equal — the open road, the given thing, the demanded thing, the fierce work, and the aftermath being not equal

k21.e: This distinction creates the HI architecture.
k21.g: from this separation the HI design is fashioned

k21.e: The base denomination is anchored to an hour, but HI is not identical to elapsed time.
k21.t: szid sag danna-bar-ta mu-un-gub • ⟦HI⟧ u4 zal-la in-nu
k21.g: the head count stands from the half-danna; HI is not the time that passed

k21.e: Qualified contribution may receive a transparent multiple, expressed as HI earned = M × hours, while the clock remains unchanged.
k21.t: nig2 sum-ma gi-na-e szid mah igi-a gal2-la szu he2-ti • ⟦HI earned = M × hours⟧ • gesz u4 szid-da nu-mu-un-bal
k21.g: the proven given-thing may receive in hand a great count standing in view — HI earned = M × hours — the day-counting implement does not turn

k21.e: One hundred actual hours remain one hundred hours even when qualified contribution produces more than one hundred HI.
k21.t: danna-bar ⟦100⟧ danna-bar ⟦100⟧-am3 • nig2 sum-ma gi-na ⟦HI⟧ ⟦100⟧-ta mah he2-dim2
k21.g: 100 half-danna are 100 half-danna, even when the proven given-thing fashions more than 100 HI

k21.e: The annual 9,999 HI boundary measures recognized contribution under the framework’s operating policy; it is not a claim that anyone works 9,999 hours.
k21.t: bar mu-ka ⟦9,999⟧ ⟦HI⟧-e nig2 sum-ma mi2 du11-ga mu-un-szid • lu2-e danna-bar ⟦9,999⟧ kin-sze3 nu-mu-un-du11
k21.g: the year-boundary of 9,999 HI counts the honored given-thing; it does not say a person works 9,999 half-danna

k21.e: Measurement of Time preserves the clock.
k21.t: nig2-szid u4-ka-ke4 gesz u4 szid-da szu mu-un-tuku
k21.g: the reckoning of time holds the day-counting implement in hand

k21.e: Local settlement translates eligible value into lawful economic reality.
k21.t: ki-bi-a nig2 gal2-la di kalam-ma-ta ku3-sze3 mu-un-bal
k21.g: in its place, the eligible thing is turned into silver under the land's law

k21.e: These layers remain separate because each answers a different question.
k21.t: bar-bi bar-ta gub-ba-am3 • disz disz-e inim bar-ra mu-un-gi4
k21.g: these stand apart — each returns (answers) a separate word

k22.g: it speaks the lifted head of humankind

k22.e: Time should not be inflated to exaggerate contribution, and contribution should not disappear because the person providing it lives somewhere poorer.
k22.t: u4 lul-sze3 na-an-gal-e • nig2 sum-ma lu2 ki ku3 tur-ra til3-la-ka na-an-zal-e
k22.g: may time not be made falsely great; may the given-thing of a person living in a place of little silver not flow away

k22.e: Money should not rewrite the historical record of what someone gave.
k22.g: may silver not overturn the tablet of what was given

k22.e: A Thought Master learns to distinguish what appears similar but carries different meaning.
k22.t: lu2 gesztu2-ga-e nig2 igi-sze3 disz-gin7 sza3-bi bar-ra mu-un-zu-zu
k22.g: the Thought Master learns the things one-like to the eye whose insides are apart

k22.t: dub gi4-gi4-e nig2 gal2-la szu mu-un-tuku
k22.g: the returning tablet holds in hand what happened

k22.e: Once these distinctions become visible, Humanity gains a common language through which people can contribute differently without first being reduced to wealth, nationality, title, geography, or access to power.
k22.t: bar-bi igi-a gub-ba-ta • nam-lu2-ulu3-e eme disz mu-un-tuku • lu2-e bar-bar-ta he2-sum • ku3-ta kalam-ta mu-ta ki-ta a2-ta igi-sze3 nu-szid-da
k22.g: when these separations stand in view, humankind holds one tongue: a person may give in his own way, not counted first by silver, land, name, place, or power

k22.e: The first instrument of Thought Mastery is therefore not the machine.
k22.t: ur5-sze3 gesz sag nam-gesztu2-ka gesz dim2-ma in-nu
k22.g: therefore the head tool of thought-mastery is not the fashioned implement

k22.e: It is honest measurement of Human time.
k22.g: it is the true reckoning of a person's time

k23.e: A thought can become a sentence, a design, an institution, a machine, a law, or a war.
k23.t: gesztu2 inim-sze3 • gesz-hur-sze3 • e2 gal-sze3 • gesz dim2-ma-sze3 • di-sze3 • a2 husz-sze3 he2-bal-e
k23.g: a thought may turn into a word, a design, a great house, a fashioned implement, a judgment, a furious arm (war)

k23.e: Humanity nevertheless spends remarkably little effort examining the path between thought and consequence.
k23.t: nam-lu2-ulu3-e kaskal gesztu2-ta egir-bi-sze3 igi tur-ta mu-un-bar
k23.g: humankind looks with a small eye at the road from thought to its aftermath

k23.e: Vision • 2525 calls that path Thought Mastery.
k23.g: Vision • 2525 gives to that road the name Thought Mastery

k23.e: It does not mean controlling every thought, eliminating uncertainty, or declaring one person intellectually superior to another.
k23.t: gesztu2 du3-a-bi szu dab5-ba in-nu • nig2 nu-zu-a zal-la in-nu • lu2 disz lu2 disz-ta mah du11-ga in-nu
k23.g: it is not the seizing of every thought; not the driving away of the unknown; not declaring one person greater than another

k23.e: It means developing enough awareness to notice assumptions before they become decisions, distinguish reaction from judgment, connect choices to consequences, and change direction when evidence proves an idea wrong.
k23.t: sza3-bi ne-e-am3 • inim sza3-ga igi ka-asz bar-ra-ka he2-pad3 • gu3 husz di-ta he2-bar • kaskal egir-bi-sze3 he2-du • nig2-gi-na-e inim lul-sze3 mu-un-gar-ra kaskal he2-bal
k23.g: its heart is this: may the heart-word be found before the decision-cutting; may the furious voice be set apart from judgment; may the chosen road be followed to its aftermath; when proof sets the word as false, may the road be turned

k23.e: The Master of Thought is therefore not a ruler.
k23.t: ur5-sze3 en sag ki lugal in-nu
k23.g: therefore EN SAG.KI is not a king

k23.e: Master of Thought names a responsibility to remain answerable for thought as it becomes action.
k23.t: en sag ki • mu nam-kin-ka-am3 • gesztu2 kin-sze3 bal-a-ra en-bi he2-me
k23.g: EN SAG.KI is the name of a charge: to be lord (answerable) over thought as it turns to work

k23.e: A Thought Master practices that responsibility through awareness rather than suppression, curiosity rather than certainty, and accountability rather than control.
k23.t: lu2 gesztu2-ga-e nam-kin-bi zu-a-ta • inim tar-ta • u3 en egir-ra-ta mu-un-kin • szu dab5-ba-ta in-nu
k23.g: the Thought Master works that charge through awareness, through question-cutting, and through lordship over the aftermath — not through the seizing hand

k24.e: At civilization scale, the same principle becomes architecture.
k24.g: in the land, this same heart turns into a design

k24.t: nig2 al du11-ga lu2-ka sza3-sze3 mu-un-bal
k24.g: a person's demanded thing turns into the heart-aim

k24.e: Intent can be heard through Collective Intelligence.
k24.g: that heart may be grasped through the people's understanding
the people's word finds the voice
the person's heart opens up its inside

k24.t: inim lu2-ka-ta nig2 al du11-ga igi-sze3 mu-un-gub
k24.g: through the person's word the demanded thing stands into view

k24.e: Requirements and risk turn intention into testable questions.
k24.t: inim gi-na u3 nig2 husz-e sza3-bi inim tar-ra-sze3 mu-un-bal
k24.g: the firm word and the fierce thing turn that heart into cuttable questions
the design gives a body to thought

k24.e: Simulation explores consequences before unnecessary exposure.
k24.t: igi-bar-e egir-bi igi kaskal husz-ka mu-un-pad3
k24.g: the looking-upon finds the aftermath before the fierce road

k24.e: Human experience reveals what models may miss.
k24.t: zu-a lu2-ka-e nig2 gesz-hur-ta zal-la mu-un-pad3
k24.g: human experience finds what flows past the design

k24.e: Verification asks whether outputs meet defined inputs.
k24.t: szid gi-na-e inim mu-un-tar • nig2 dim2-ma inim gar-ra-gin7 he2-gal2
k24.g: the firm count cuts the question: is the fashioned thing as the placed word?

k24.e: Validation asks whether the result serves its intended purpose.
k24.t: szid zi-e inim mu-un-tar • nig2 dim2-ma sag sza3-ga-bi-sze3 he2-du
k24.g: the true count cuts the question: does the fashioned thing go toward its heart-aim?

k24.e: Qualification states what the evidence permits.
k24.g: the seal of proof speaks what is permitted

k24.t: dub gi4-gi4-e nig2 gal2-la szu mu-un-tuku
k24.g: the returning tablet holds in hand what happened
the matching count finds what turned

k24.e: Cause records why a change was made.
k24.t: inim sag-e sag nig2 bal-a-ka mu-un-sar
k24.g: the head-word writes the head (reason) of the changed thing

k24.e: Learning returns into the next cycle.
k24.g: learning returns into the next ring

k24.e: Thought no longer disappears when the meeting ends.
k24.g: when the gathering has passed, thought does not flow away

k24.e: It leaves a path another Human can examine, challenge, understand, and improve.
k24.t: kaskal mu-un-gar • lu2 egir-ra-e igi he2-bar • inim he2-tar • he2-zu • sig5-sze3 he2-bal
k24.g: it sets down a road — the person after may look upon it, cut questions at it, know it, turn it toward the better

k25.e: This is the deeper meaning of Innovation at the Speed of Thought.
k25.t: ne-e sza3 gid2-da nig2 dim2-ma gesztu2-gin7 du-a-ka-am3
k25.g: this is the long inside (deeper meaning) of the making that goes like thought

k25.e: It is not the speed with which AI generates an answer.
k25.t: u4 tur inim gi4-a gesztu2 dim2-ma-ka in-nu
k25.g: it is not the small time of the fashioned understanding's returned word

k25.e: Speed without awareness can accelerate error.
k25.t: du husz zu-a nu-gal2-la-ta nig2 nu-si-sa2 gal-sze3 mu-un-du
k25.g: fierce going without awareness makes the crooked thing go greater

k25.e: The objective is to shorten the distance between imagination and qualified learning while preserving the disciplines that make learning trustworthy.
k25.t: sag-bi • kaskal igi-bar sza3-ga-ta zu-zu gi-na-sze3 he2-tur • kaskal gi-na zu-zu-ka szu he2-tuku
k25.g: its aim: may the road from heart-vision to proven learning become small, while the firm way of learning is held in hand

k25.e: Thought Mastery is available to every person: see clearly, imagine freely, question assumptions, listen beyond yourself, test before claiming, admit uncertainty, preserve mistakes, and improve through evidence.
k25.t: nam-gesztu2 lu2 du3-a-bi-ra gal2-la-am3 • igi gi-na-ta he2-bar • sza3-ta igi-bar he2-gar • inim sza3-ga he2-tar • gu3 bar-ra he2-tuku • igi inim-ka he2-szid • nig2 nu-zu-a he2-du11 • nig2 nu-si-sa2 szu he2-tuku • nig2-gi-na-ta sig5-sze3 he2-bal
k25.g: thought-mastery exists for every person: may one look with a true eye; set vision forth from the heart; cut questions at the heart-word; grasp the outside voice; count before the word (test before claiming); speak the unknown; hold the crooked things in hand; turn toward the better through proof

k25.e: Anyone willing to practice those habits can become a Thought Master.
k25.g: the person who walks these roads is a Thought Master

k25.e: When millions can practice them while technology assists coordination, Humanity gains something greater than faster machines: the capacity to think together without requiring everyone to think alike.
k25.t: un gal-gal kaskal-bi du-a-ta • gesz dim2-ma a2 sum-ma-ta • nam-lu2-ulu3-e nig2 mah szu mu-un-ti • gesztu2 gu2-sze3 gar-ra • sza3 disz-sze3 nu-dab5-ba
k25.g: when great numbers of people walk these roads, the implement giving its arm, humankind receives a great thing in hand: thought gathered together, the heart not seized into one

k26.e: Vision • 2525 begins with Humanity because every other layer is a means.
k26.t: ⟦Vision • 2525⟧ nam-lu2-ulu3-ta mu-un-gub • nig2 bar-ra du3-a-bi kaskal-am3
k26.g: Vision • 2525 stands from humankind — every other thing is a way (means)
the place of silver is a way
the great house is a way
the fashioned understanding is a way

k26.e: The purpose is Human flourishing across generations while preserving dignity, freedom, responsibility, agency, and the ability of people to shape systems affecting their lives.
k26.t: sag-bi nam-til3 sig5 nam-lu2-ulu3-ka dumu-ta dumu-sze3-am3 • sag il2-la u3 szu bar-ra szu tuku-am3 • un-e gesz-hur zi-bi-ka a2 he2-tuku
k26.g: its aim is humankind's good life from child to child — the lifted head and the released hand held fast — may the people hold power over the designs of their lives

k26.e: Human Authority therefore occupies a protected position in the architecture.
k26.t: ur5-sze3 nam-en nam-lu2-ulu3-ka ki gi-na gesz-hur-ka mu-un-gub
k26.g: therefore the lordship of humankind stands in a firm place of the design

k26.e: Technology can expand perception, organize complexity, simulate possibilities, translate languages, identify patterns, preserve knowledge, and challenge Human reasoning.
k26.t: gesz dim2-ma-e igi gal-sze3 he2-gar • nig2 gal-gal si he2-sa2 • igi-bar he2-gar • eme-ta eme-sze3 he2-bal • gesz-hur he2-pad3 • nig2 zu-a szu he2-tuku • inim lu2-ka inim he2-tar
k26.g: the fashioned implement may make the eye great, set the great things in order, set forth lookings-upon, turn tongue into tongue, find the designs, hold knowledge in hand, and cut questions at human words
may it go toward great strength

k26.e: But capability and authority are different questions.
k26.g: strength and lordship are separate words

k26.e: A system may know more, calculate faster, or detect patterns beyond ordinary Human perception without acquiring the right to determine what Humanity should value, become, accept, or surrender.
k26.t: gesz dim2-ma-e mah he2-zu • u4 tur-ta he2-szid • gesz-hur igi lu2-ka-ta zal-la he2-pad3 • nam-en ka-asz nam-lu2-ulu3-ka-ka szu nu-mu-un-ti
k26.g: the implement may know more, count in smaller time, find designs that pass the human eye — yet it does not receive in hand the lordship over humankind's decision

k27.e: This distinction becomes more important as AI grows more powerful.
k27.t: gesztu2 dim2-ma a2 mah-sze3 du-a-ta bar-bi mah-sze3 mu-un-du
k27.g: as the fashioned understanding goes toward great strength, this separation goes toward greatness

k27.e: Artificial Intelligence may discover an option no Human considered.
k27.t: gesztu2 dim2-ma-e kaskal lu2 nu-igi-bar-ra he2-pad3
k27.g: the fashioned understanding may find a road no person looked upon

k27.e: Collective Intelligence may reveal priorities no leader expected.
k27.t: gesztu2 un-ka-e nig2 sag lu2 sag-e nu-zu-a he2-pad3
k27.g: the people's understanding may find head-things the head-person did not know

k27.e: Spiritual Intelligence may challenge whether an efficient course remains worthy.
k27.t: gesztu2 zi-ka-e inim he2-tar • kaskal u4 tur-ra zi-sze3 he2-gal2
k27.g: the spirit's understanding may cut the question: does the swift road remain true?

k27.e: Human Intelligence integrates lived experience, responsibility, imagination, judgment, and consequence.
k27.t: gesztu2 lu2-ka-e zu-a til3-la • nam-kin • igi-bar sza3-ga • di • u3 egir-bi gu2-sze3 mu-un-gar
k27.g: human understanding gathers together lived knowledge, the charge, heart-vision, judgment, and the aftermath

k27.e: Vision • 2525 welcomes contribution from these forms of intelligence while keeping consequential authority attached to accountable Human governance.
k27.t: ⟦Vision • 2525⟧-e nig2 sum-ma gesztu2-bi-e-ne-ka hul2-ta szu mu-un-ti • ka-asz gal nam-en lu2 gi-na-ka-ta gub-ba-am3
k27.g: Vision • 2525 receives with joy the given-things of these understandings; the great decision stands with the lordship of the answerable person

k27.e: That authority must itself remain bounded: reviewable, explainable, reversible where possible, subject to applicable law, and capable of being withdrawn.
k27.t: nam-en-bi bar tuku-am3 • igi-sze3 he2-bar • sza3-bi he2-du11 • he2-gi4-gi4 • di kalam-ma-ka he2-gub • szu-ta he2-e3
k27.g: that lordship holds a boundary: it may be looked into, its inside spoken, returned (reversed), it stands under the land's law, and it may go out of the hand (be withdrawn)

k27.e: Human Authority is not permission for Human domination.
k27.t: nam-en nam-lu2-ulu3-ka szu dab5-ba lu2-ta lu2-sze3 in-nu
k27.g: humankind's lordship is not a seizing hand of person over person

k27.e: It is the place where responsibility must ultimately remain answerable.
k27.g: it is the place where the charge returns the word (answers)

k28.e: Thought Mastery stands inside this relationship as discipline rather than supremacy.
k28.t: nam-gesztu2 sza3-bi-a kaskal gi-na-gin7 mu-un-gub • nam-mah-sze3 in-nu
k28.g: thought-mastery stands inside this as a firm way; it is not for supremacy

k28.e: It asks Humanity to become capable enough to govern increasingly capable tools.
k28.t: nam-lu2-ulu3-ra inim mu-un-tar • gesz a2 mah-sze3 du-a-e-ne en-bi he2-me
k28.g: it cuts a word to humankind: may you be lord over the implements going toward great strength
may the fashioned understanding not turn into the seizing hand

k28.e: Spiritual Intelligence should not become compulsory belief.
k28.t: gesztu2 zi-ka inim a2 dab5-ba-sze3 na-an-bal-e
k28.g: may the spirit's understanding not turn into a word seized by force

k28.e: Human Intelligence should not become ego.
k28.g: may human understanding not turn into a swollen heart

k28.e: Collective Intelligence should not become mob authority.
k28.t: gesztu2 un-ka nam-en un husz-a-sze3 na-an-bal-e
k28.g: may the people's understanding not turn into the lordship of a furious crowd

k28.e: Each contributes something the others cannot supply alone.
k28.t: disz disz-e nig2-bi mu-un-sum • lu2 asz-e du3-a-bi nu-mu-un-sum
k28.g: each gives its own thing; one alone does not give all

k28.e: The task is integration without confusion.
k28.g: the task is the gathering together, with no muddle in it

k28.e: Vision • 2525 therefore reduces its doctrine to three sentences: Humanity decides. Technology assists. Trust must be proven.
k28.t: ⟦Vision • 2525⟧-e inim-bi inim tur-sze3 mu-un-tur • nam-lu2-ulu3-e ka-asz mu-un-bar • gesz dim2-ma-e a2 mu-un-sum • nig2 gi-na igi-a he2-gal2
k28.g: Vision • 2525 makes its word small into short words: humankind cuts the decision • the fashioned implement gives its arm • may the firm thing stand in view

k28.e: Thought Mastery carries the responsibility beneath them: know what you are deciding, understand what is assisting you, preserve evidence behind the decision, recognize uncertainty, and remain willing to change when reality teaches something better.
k28.t: nam-gesztu2-e nam-kin sig-bi szu mu-un-tuku • nig2 ka-asz bar-ra-zu he2-zu • nig2 a2 sum-ma-zu he2-zu • nig2-gi-na ka-asz-ka szu he2-tuku • nig2 nu-zu-a he2-du11 • ki gi-na-e nig2 sig5 zu-zu-a-ta kaskal he2-bal
k28.g: thought-mastery holds in hand the low (underlying) charge: may you know your decision-cutting; know what gives you its arm; hold in hand the proof of the decision; speak the unknown; and when the firm ground teaches a better thing, may the road be turned

k29.e: No leader, institution, company, model, or nation can contain Humanity’s total experience.
k29.t: lu2 sag • e2 gal • e2 kin-ka • gesztu2 dim2-ma • kalam • disz-e zu-a du3-a-bi nam-lu2-ulu3-ka szu nu-mu-un-ti
k29.g: head-person, great house, house of work, fashioned understanding, land — no one of them receives in hand all humankind's knowledge

k29.e: Knowledge lives everywhere: in classrooms and workshops, farms and laboratories, families and communities, professions and cultures, successes and failures.
k29.t: nig2 zu-a ki du3-a-bi-a til3-la-am3 • e2-dub-ba-a u3 e2 kin-ka • a-sza3-ga u3 e2 igi-bar-ka • e2-a u3 un-na • nam-kin-a u3 kalam-kalam-a • nig2 sa2-a u3 nig2 nu-sa2-a
k29.g: the known thing lives in every place: in the tablet-house and the work-house, in the field and the looking-house, in the household and among the people, in the professions and in the lands, in the attained thing and the unattained thing

k29.e: Much of that knowledge never reaches the place where decisions are made.
k29.t: zu-a-bi gal ki ka-asz bar-ra-sze3 nu-mu-un-du
k29.g: much of that knowledge does not go to the place of decision-cutting

k29.e: Collective Intelligence is Vision • 2525’s method for helping distributed Human experience become visible without pretending that the loudest, richest, largest, most powerful, or most popular signal must be correct.
k29.t: gesztu2 un-ka kaskal ⟦Vision • 2525⟧-ka-am3 • zu-a lu2 bar-bar-ka igi-sze3 mu-un-tum2 • gu3 gal • ku3 gal • un gal • a2 gal • gi-na-am3 nu-mu-un-du11
k29.g: the people's understanding is Vision • 2525's road: it brings the knowledge of scattered persons into view; it does not say the great voice, the great silver, the great crowd, the great power is thereby true

k29.e: Humanity must learn to listen at scale while preserving the ability to think critically about what it hears.
k29.t: nam-lu2-ulu3 gal-sze3 gesztu2-sze3 he2-zu-zu • nig2 gesztu2-e tuku-a-ra inim he2-tar
k29.g: may humankind learn to listen at great scale — and may it cut questions at what the ear grasps

k29.e: Participation can reveal knowledge that centralized systems miss, but participation alone does not convert opinion into evidence.
k29.t: un du-a-ta zu-a ki sag-ta zal-la he2-pad3 • inim un-ka asz-bi nig2-gi-na-sze3 nu-mu-un-bal
k29.g: through the people's coming, knowledge that flows past the head-place may be found; the people's word alone does not turn into proof

k29.e: Collective Intelligence becomes valuable when diverse signals can enter a process without losing their origin, disagreement, uncertainty, or meaning.
k29.t: gesztu2 un-ka ku3-am3 • gu3 bar-bar kaskal-sze3 du-a-ta • ki-bi • inim bar-ra-bi • nig2 nu-zu-a-bi • sza3-bi nu-mu-un-zal
k29.g: the people's understanding is precious when the various voices go into the road (process) and their place (origin), their apart-word (disagreement), their unknown, and their inside (meaning) do not flow away
